§ 01 · The Program

A complete
portfolio.

From foundational B1 manufacturing vocabulary to advanced C1 operations and engineering discourse, every module is anchored in real-world manufacturing scenarios — from production planning to quality control, from lean manufacturing to smart factory technology. Built for use inside manufacturing plants, industrial engineering teams, supply chain operations, and manufacturing technology firms.

01

Industry-anchored

Every question reflects real terminology from production floors, quality control, and industrial automation in 2026.

02

AI & automation

Smart factories, predictive maintenance, and robotic process automation run throughout the program — reflecting today's manufacturing industry.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with executive-level performance feedback and improvement guidance after every exercise.

Mini case studies bring real manufacturing dilemmas — quality defects, supply disruptions, safety incidents — into language learning.

Brice Gadou

Business English Expert

Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international professionals. Manu reflects his vision: language learning as operational precision — a multiplier of careers, teams, and production excellence.

Designed for the plant managers, engineers, and operations leaders shaping global industry — Manu is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to produce in one of the most essential sectors of our time.
